```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .ext-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .ext-header {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 30% 1fr;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .ext-header-cell {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ext-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 30% 1fr;
    align-items: stretch;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .ext-row:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }

  .ext-layer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #EEEDF8;
  }

  .ext-row:hover .ext-layer { background: #E6E5F4; }

  .ext-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .ext-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .ext-name {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .ext-resp {
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: 0.95em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .ext-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: center; }
    .ext-header-cell:last-child { display: none; }
    .ext-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .ext-layer { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; padding: 10px 14px; }
    .ext-resp { padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.9em; }
  }
</style>

<div class="ext-outer">
  <div class="ext-header">
    <div class="ext-header-cell">Type</div>
    <div class="ext-header-cell">Description</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ext-row">
    <div class="ext-layer">
      <div class="ext-icon"><i data-lucide="package"></i></div>
      <div class="ext-name">Plugins</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ext-resp">Bundles of skills, MCPs, and configuration. Install via <code>/plugin</code> and manage locally.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ext-row">
    <div class="ext-layer">
      <div class="ext-icon"><i data-lucide="plug"></i></div>
      <div class="ext-name">MCPs (Connectors)</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ext-resp">External servers that give Claude real-time access to tools and data — web browsing, calendars, databases, and more.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ext-row">
    <div class="ext-layer">
      <div class="ext-icon"><i data-lucide="zap"></i></div>
      <div class="ext-name">Skills</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ext-resp">Slash commands (e.g. <code>/commit</code>, <code>/review</code>) that encode reusable workflows as Markdown prompt templates.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
